title: Verminvaders strategy response
description: The answer the strategic brain (Mistral) must return at every consultation: opening, wave plan, epoch update and post-mortem. Enforced by the API in strict json_schema mode; ranges are clamped again locally by normalizeParams.

params.description: The executor weights. Send every field on every answer; out-of-range values are clamped locally.

chewShields.description: allow one deliberate hole per shield

dodgeHorizonS.description: 0.3..1.6, react to crumbs landing within this window

acceptHitBelowS.description: 0.05..0.5, stop dodging when impact is nearer

columnSpreadWeight.description: 0..10, penalty for killing a column's last rodent

rowWeights.description: exactly 5 numbers 0..10, per-row urgency multipliers (index = row, 0 = top/rats)

colAvoid.description: exactly 8 numbers 0..10, per-column targeting penalty (-100 per point)

livesRisk.description: exactly 3 numbers 0..10, risk appetite at 3/2/1 lives; 5 = neutral

aimJitterPx.description: 0..10, seeded random aim error in px

travelCost.description: 0..10, laziness: each point penalizes target scores by 1 per 10 px of glide distance; 0 = distance ignored

rngSeed.description: seed for the executor RNG; a fixed seed replays the executor's choices identically

verminSeed.description: seed for the vermin firing RNG

notes.description: one short paragraph summarizing your reasoning this consultation

memory.description: your persistent state, any JSON shape you want: lessons learned, parameter history, strategy rationale (under 300 words once serialized); consolidated and deduplicated at post-mortems

gameSummary.description: ONLY in post-mortem calls: one concise strategy summary of the finished game (under 80 words); send an empty string in the other calls
